en.title: Carousel Music Box with Lights, Wind-Up 3-Horse Musical Carousel Playing You are My Sunshine, Hand-Painted Resin Keepsake for Daughter, Granddaughter, Girls and Women
bullets: **A MAGICAL KEEPSAKE FOR SOMEONE SPECIAL** – Celebrate the person who brings sunshine into your life with an elegant carousel music box playing “You Are My Sunshine.” A meaningful keepsake for daughters, granddaughters, girls, girlfriends, wives and women

**WIND-UP CAROUSEL WITH 3 HORSES** – Turn the key on the bottom to activate the traditional 18-note musical movement. The three carousel horses gently revolve as the familiar melody plays, creating a nostalgic moment without requiring batteries for the music

**SOFT LIGHTS CREATE A DREAMY GLOW** – Built-in decorative lights illuminate the carousel and highlight its sculpted details. The warm, colorful glow makes it especially charming on a bedside table, dresser, shelf or display cabinet

**HAND-PAINTED RESIN CRAFTSMANSHIP** – Made from durable polyresin with carved scrollwork, gold-tone accents and individually painted carousel horses. Slight variations in the hand-painted finish make every music box uniquely personal

**READY FOR GIFTING AND DISPLAY** – Measuring approximately 5.9 inches tall and 3.2 inches wide, this compact musical figurine fits easily into bedrooms, nurseries, offices and living spaces. A memorable birthday, Christmas, Valentine’s Day or anniversary gift

ko.headline: 하나만 둬도 공간이 달라져요
for_whom: 국내에 없는 해외 디자인을 찾는 분

sections.title: 선물로도 좋아요
sections.body: 받는 사람이 두고두고 보는 선물이라 오래 기억에 남아요.

sections.title: 자주 보는 자리에
sections.body: 선반 위처럼 눈이 자주 가는 곳에 두세요. 작은 소품 하나가 공간의 인상을 바꿔요.

faq.a: 상품 정보의 크기를 확인해 주세요. 두실 자리를 먼저 재 보시면 좋아요.
완충 포장해 보내드려요. 받으신 뒤 문제가 있으면 바로 연락 주세요.

cautions: 전기를 쓰는 제품은 현지 전압·플러그 규격을 확인해 주세요.
ko.closing: 보는 순간 기분 좋은 한 점
